race.comment: ELLIS BEACH (1) grows a leg for hoop Holt who has four wins and two placings from just eight steers and is racing very consistently of late. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble and should be right there when the whips are cracking. INTRUDER (3) got the job done over this course and distance last time out and winning rider Goring sticks in the irons. Again gets the benefit of his 3kg claim and should prove hard to hold out. LONE FORCE (6) has placed three of four around this circuit and is usually around the money. In the mix. EAGLE WARRIOR (5) best of the rest from the low draw.
